issue_request: FHIR-32111 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction raised for R4B and applied for R5. It requested adding structuredefinition-explicit-type-name value ContributorshipSummary to Citation contributorship summary to avoid code-generator problems caused by recursive contributorship structure; the implemented element path was Citation.citedArtifact.contributorship.summary.
initial_application: Jira records implementation commits 350cc71f03 for R5 and 72eda94964 for R4B. Both commits added the requested explicit type name extension to source/citation/structuredefinition-Citation.xml at Citation.citedArtifact.contributorship.summary, and the R5 published Citation profile still exposes that extension.
additional_context: Current core no longer builds Citation. Commit 71567db3ee039ac6977be5f96a7e013896569a36 removed source/citation/structuredefinition-Citation.xml and active Citation fhir.ini entries. Current searches found no active Citation StructureDefinition in core or the FHIR Extension Pack, and source/fhir.ini now only has a commented citation-related value set entry.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The historical R4B/R5 target is already correct, and the current core checkout has no build-scope Citation source to edit without reintroducing an intentionally removed resource.
